questions.prompt: Which of these is a mammal?
questions.hint: It breathes air and feeds milk to its babies.
questions.fact: Dolphins breathe air and feed milk to their babies.

questions.prompt: Which animal has babies that are born alive?
questions.hint: A baby of this animal is called a calf.
questions.fact: Cows are mammals, so their calves are born alive.

questions.prompt: What do mammal mothers feed their babies?
questions.hint: Think of what a baby drinks.
questions.fact: All mammal mothers make milk for their young.

questions.prompt: Which mammal can truly fly?
questions.fact: Bats are the only mammals that can fly.

questions.prompt: Which is the biggest animal on Earth?
questions.fact: The blue whale is the largest animal ever known.

questions.prompt: Which mammal lives in the ocean?
questions.hint: It comes up to breathe air.
questions.fact: Whales are mammals that live in the sea.

questions.prompt: Which animal hops?
questions.fact: Rabbits have strong back legs that help them hop.

questions.prompt: Which animal purrs when it is happy?
questions.hint: It likes to curl up on your lap.
questions.fact: Cats purr when they feel calm and happy.

questions.prompt: Which animal is an apex predator?
questions.fact: Lions sit at the top of their food chain, so nothing hunts them.

questions.prompt: Which animal can turn its head almost all the way round?
questions.fact: Owls can turn their heads about three quarters of the way around.

questions.prompt: Which animal is a bird?
questions.hint: Look for the one with wings.
questions.fact: Owls have feathers and wings, so they are birds.

questions.prompt: Which animal has a bushy tail and a pointed nose?
questions.fact: Foxes use their bushy tails for balance and to keep warm.

questions.prompt: Which animal has a mane?
questions.hint: It is called the king of the jungle.
questions.fact: Male lions grow a thick mane around their heads.

questions.prompt: Which animal has long ears?
questions.fact: A rabbit's long ears help it hear danger from far away.

questions.prompt: Which animal lives in a group called a pride?
questions.fact: A pride is a family group of lions.

questions.prompt: Which animal hunts by flying silently?
questions.fact: Soft feathers help owls fly without making a sound.

questions.prompt: Which bird cannot fly?
questions.fact: Penguins use their wings like flippers to swim.

questions.prompt: What covers a bird's body?
questions.fact: Feathers keep birds warm and help them fly.

questions.prompt: Which animal lays eggs in a nest?
questions.fact: Robins build nests and lay blue eggs.

questions.prompt: Which bird can copy human words?
questions.fact: Parrots can copy sounds and words they hear.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest bird alive?
questions.fact: An ostrich can grow taller than a grown-up.

questions.prompt: What do birds use to fly?
questions.hint: They flap them up and down.
questions.fact: Wings lift birds into the air as they flap.

questions.prompt: Which sea animal has eight arms?
questions.fact: An octopus has eight arms covered in suckers.

questions.prompt: What do fish use to breathe underwater?
questions.hint: They are on the sides of the head.
questions.fact: Gills take oxygen from the water.

questions.prompt: Which sea animal is shaped like a star?
questions.fact: Most starfish have five arms.

questions.prompt: Which sea animal has claws and a hard shell?
questions.fact: Crabs walk sideways on their strong legs.

questions.prompt: Which sea animal has a tall fin and sharp teeth?
questions.fact: Sharks are fish with skeletons made of bendy cartilage.

questions.fact: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.

questions.prompt: Which shape has no corners?
questions.fact: A circle is perfectly round, so it has no corners.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a square have?
questions.fact: A square has 4 equal sides and 4 corners.

questions.prompt: Which shape has four equal sides?

questions.prompt: What does a plant need to make its food?
questions.fact: Plants use sunlight and water to make their food.

questions.prompt: Which part of a plant takes in water?
questions.fact: Roots soak up water from the soil.

questions.prompt: What do plants give us to breathe?
questions.hint: We need it with every breath.
questions.fact: Plants make oxygen that people and animals breathe.

questions.prompt: What grows from a seed?
questions.fact: A seed holds a tiny new plant inside.

questions.prompt: Which part of a plant catches sunlight?
questions.fact: Leaves catch sunlight to help the plant make food.

questions.prompt: What carries water up through a plant?
questions.hint: It holds the plant up too.
questions.fact: The stem moves water from the roots to the leaves.

questions.prompt: Which insect carries pollen between flowers?
questions.fact: Bees carry pollen, which helps flowers make seeds.

questions.prompt: What is the colourful part of a flower called?
questions.hint: It can be red, pink or yellow.
questions.fact: Petals attract bees and other helpful insects.
